map.输入能见度、路面温度、风速，综合评估低能见度、结冰、侧风等不利气象对交通安全的影: Enter the visibility, road surface temperature and wind speed to comprehensively assess the impact of adverse weather such as low visibility, icing and crosswind on traffic safety and output a warning level.
map.📖 查看「交通气象安全提示 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Traffic Meteorological Safety Advisory User Guide"
map.道路气象安全按三项分级综合研判：能见度 vis（<50m 特级、<200m 红、: Road meteorological safety is judged by grading three items: visibility (vis) (<50 m special grade, <200 m red, <500 m orange, <1000 m yellow, otherwise good), road surface temperature (rt) (<−3°C red, <0°C orange, <2°C yellow), and crosswind (v) (≥24 m/s red, stepping down). If any item reaches red/orange, the corresponding control advice (speed limit, anti-skid, closure) is given to ensure driving safety.
map.💡 能见度<50m 强浓雾(特级)、50-200 浓雾(红)、200-500 雾: 💡 Visibility <50 m dense fog (special grade), 50-200 dense fog (red), 200-500 fog (orange), 500-1000 mist (yellow); road surface temperature <0°C icing risk; wind speed ≥17 m/s strong crosswind.
map.预警等级取能见度、结冰、侧风三项风险的最高级别: The warning level takes the highest of the three risks: visibility, icing and crosswind
map.路面温度低于 0°C 时需结合湿度判断实际结冰，本工具按温度预警: When the road surface temperature is below 0°C, humidity must be considered to judge actual icing; this tool warns by temperature
map.侧风影响对高速公路桥梁、高架路段尤为显著: The crosswind effect is particularly significant on highway bridges and elevated sections
map.按能见度/路面温度/风给道路安全提示。: Give road safety advisories by visibility / road surface temperature / wind.
map.雾、冻雨、横风路段分级预警。: Graded warning for fog, freezing rain and crosswind sections.
map.导航叠加气象做限速/绕行建议。: Navigation overlays weather to give speed-limit / detour advice.
map.能见度 200 m → 属浓雾（<500m），提示开雾灯、限速 60、保持车距，: Visibility 200 m → dense fog (<500 m); advise turning on fog lights, limiting speed to 60, keeping distance, and the highway may be closed.
map.路面温度 −2°C 且有降水 → 结冰风险，提示装防滑链/禁行，桥面比普通路更早: Road surface temperature −2°C with precipitation → icing risk; advise fitting snow chains / no driving; bridge decks freeze earlier than ordinary roads.
map.≥1000m 正常、500–1000 较大影响、<500 浓雾（高速易封）、<2: ≥1000 m normal, 500-1000 significant impact, <500 dense fog (highways easily closed), <200 extremely dense fog.
map.桥梁、风口、高速跨线桥，侧风使车辆偏移，大车尤甚，提示降速握稳。: On bridges, wind gaps and highway overpasses; the crosswind pushes vehicles off course, especially large vehicles; advise slowing down and gripping the wheel.
map.输入能见度、路面温度和风速，分别评估低能见度（雾）、路面结冰和强侧风三项气象风险: Enter the visibility, road surface temperature and wind speed to individually assess the three meteorological risks of low visibility (fog), road icing and strong crosswind, take the highest as the comprehensive traffic meteorological warning level, and give graded control advice.
